_doc: Graphics tiers (scripts/autoload/Graphics.gd). high = today's look (the GTX 1060): the yard renders exactly as YardLight and project.godot set it; the only keys are the frame cap (60, with vsync on: on a 120 Hz output every frame is two refreshes, steady pacing; D117, over 120 Hz vsync rounding frames). low = the Intel HD 530 (Skylake GT2): every key below overrides one setting. Auto-pick at boot from the adapter; -- --graphics=low|high overrides. Not in low on purpose: camera_far / fog_depth_* (Graphics supports them). The yard is a closed diorama with its painted sky 95 m behind the fence; the wide shot sits ~150 m from the sky, so a shorter far cut the sky off and the depth fog tinted the whole yard the horizon teal (jyz-igpu-1 shots). Nothing lies beyond the sky to cull.
